objective: Find which zero-depth and positive-depth owner/sign summaries remain sufficient in the pooled native carrier.
source: SIGNED_PARITY roleless C sign counts and owner/sign count matrix separately at depth0 and positive depths.

candidateGrid.product: All36 ordered pairs of summaries; keep C+ and C- token counts exact.

maps.TOTAL: For each sign separately, owner0+owner1 count.
maps.ABS_NET: For each sign separately, absolute owner0-owner1 count.
maps.SIGN_UNORDERED: For each sign separately, sorted pair of owner counts.
maps.OWNER_PAIR_UNORDERED: Sorted pair of owner vectors [positiveSignCount,negativeSignCount] within the stratum.
maps.OWNER_SEPARATED: Ordered two owner vectors within the stratum.

procedure: Test summaries against owner swaps and elementary refinement relations.
Freeze all36 catalogs, rows, complete kernels and deterministic bases, then commit before scalar replay.
Replay all3 fixed target characters and per-carrier/pooled factorization; reproduce the full ordered-owner control.
Report the complete grid; do not infer untested universal minimality from ranks.
guards: ABS_NET alone need not refine TOTAL; no ordering is assumed without proof.
Labels refer to token-count summaries, not arithmetic on saturated bins.
This tests matched-dependency Q_V, not independent board-value classification or a scalar coefficient formula.
